restrictions: Complete sha256-r31-prefix-v1 hash: standard IV, FIPS 180-4 padding, steps 0..30 on every block with feed-forward, all 256 digest bits; messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' of 128 bytes.
One run of proof.md Section 5 with the advice of Section 4 (Table 6 of Li-Liu-Wang EUROCRYPT 2024 and 65 base points) and N = 188345456 random first blocks; collision-frontier-v5 units.

Time is a sum of exact operation counts times per-iteration bounds (proof.md Section 7), including the construction of the advice with a 4x margin; the one-time search that produced Table 6 is not charged.
lambda = 1.000 is computed from exact counts (table size 75675936, |V6| = 2^23, exhaustive split probability) under heuristics H1 and H2; run statistics and certificates are supporting evidence only.
baseline_improved is the required reference identifier only.

heuristics.statement: For uniformly random first blocks the chaining value is uniform: the number of table hits per block has mean E/2^32, and at a hit W6, W5 and the W18 offset W11 + s0(W3) + W2 are uniform and independent, so the per-hit success probability is 2^-9 * p_split with p_split = 2846011149340672/2^64.
heuristics.scope: 31-step chaining values of random first blocks from the standard IV, and the words derived from them in P4.
heuristics.extrapolation: Standard random-function behaviour of the reduced compression for the chaining-value words used; exact counts are used for all sets.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved; consistent with the observed hit, W6 and split rates of the runs in Section 6 (ratios near 1).

heuristics.statement: Successes of distinct (first block, table entry) pairs are rare and nearly independent, so the success probability is 1 - exp(-lambda) with lambda = 1.000.
heuristics.scope: The whole online algorithm at the stated parameters and advice.
heuristics.limitations: Approximation; the observed success frequency of the runs in Section 6 agrees with it and the claim 0.55 is below 0.632.

heuristics.statement: After a W20-split event, step P5 finds E13 and E15 within its caps, giving a collision.
heuristics.scope: Step P5 for the matched first blocks of the certificates and of the runs.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 16 matched first blocks re-completed under organizer seeds and all split events of the runs.
heuristics.limitations: A rare completion failure would only lower the success probability slightly.
